disposition.impact: The excluded reverse-order sample is not needed to select grid 144. The fully valid 160-to-144 repeat measured both M=1 arms at 2272 MHz with identical 20.032 microsecond medians. The reverse-order M=4 comparison also had stable 2257/2265 MHz clocks and identical 20.064 microsecond medians. Grid 144 uses 10 percent less FP32 scratch than grid 160.

observation.reason: The post-timing active GPU snapshot was not clock-comparable with the grid-144 M=1 snapshot at 2280 MHz.
